blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Sports Commission (CPSC) has contingency plans in place to ensure the smooth staging of the ongoing Cebu Governor’s Cup U-18 Basketball Tournament even in the event of typhoons, natural calamities, and other unforeseen disruptions. CPSC Commissioner Mark Anthony Ynoc, the project proponent of the provincewide tournament, said they were prepared to extend the tournament beyond its projected timeline if calamities would force the postponement of games. In an interview with CDN Digital during the Governor’s Cup opening ceremony last Sunday at the Mandaue City Sports and Cultural Complex, Ynoc said alternative venues had already […]...
